clickhouse-otel installed.

In-cluster DNS (namespace: observability):
  clickhouse-otel.observability.svc.cluster.local
    HTTP   : 8123  (ad-hoc queries / /ping health)
    native : 9000  (OTel clickhouseexporter writes)

Database: {{ .Values.database }}  (the clickhouseexporter auto-creates its
tables/MVs here when create_schema: true).

Credentials:
{{- if .Values.auth.createPlaceholderSecret }}
  WARNING: an in-chart PLACEHOLDER Secret ({{ .Values.auth.existingSecret }}) is
  active. This is DEV ONLY — set auth.createPlaceholderSecret=false in prod and
  provision {{ .Values.auth.existingSecret }} via an ExternalSecret from GCP SM.
{{- else }}
  Secret "{{ .Values.auth.existingSecret }}" (key: {{ .Values.auth.secretKey }})
  must exist in the observability namespace — provisioned by an ExternalSecret
  synced from GCP Secret Manager.
{{- end }}

OTel Collector clickhouseexporter snippet:
  exporters:
    clickhouse:
      endpoint: tcp://clickhouse-otel.observability.svc.cluster.local:9000?dial_timeout=10s
      database: {{ .Values.database }}
      username: {{ .Values.auth.user }}
      password: ${env:CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD}
      create_schema: true
